<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$errors = array();
$ok = array();
if ( 'maison-calista-theme' !== get_option( 'stylesheet' ) ) {
  $errors[] = 'Theme not active';
} else {
  $ok[] = 'Theme active v' . wp_get_theme()->get( 'Version' );
}
if ( ! function_exists( 'maison_calista_demo_is_complete' ) ) {
  $errors[] = 'demo helpers missing';
} else {
  if ( ! maison_calista_demo_is_complete() ) {
    maison_calista_run_setup_safe( true );
    $ok[] = 'Setup invoked explicitly after activate';
  }
  if ( maison_calista_demo_is_complete() ) {
    $ok[] = 'Demo complete after activate';
  } else {
    $errors[] = 'Demo incomplete after activate';
  }
}
$required = array( 'home', 'about-maison-calista', 'the-residence', 'care-support', 'family', 'activities', 'restaurant', 'stays-pricing', 'gallery', 'contact' );
$missing = array();
foreach ( $required as $slug ) {
  if ( ! get_page_by_path( $slug ) ) {
    $missing[] = $slug;
  }
}
if ( $missing ) {
  $errors[] = 'Missing pages: ' . implode( ',', $missing );
} else {
  $ok[] = 'Core pages present (' . count( $required ) . ')';
}
$home = get_page_by_path( 'home' );
if ( $home && (int) get_option( 'page_on_front' ) === (int) $home->ID && 'page' === get_option( 'show_on_front' ) ) {
  $ok[] = 'Front page = Accueil/home';
} else {
  $errors[] = 'Front page not assigned to home';
}
$locations = get_theme_mod( 'nav_menu_locations', array() );
if ( ! empty( $locations['primary'] ) ) {
  $ok[] = 'Primary menu assigned';
} else {
  $errors[] = 'Primary menu missing';
}
if ( ! empty( $locations['footer'] ) ) {
  $ok[] = 'Footer menu assigned';
} else {
  $errors[] = 'Footer menu missing';
}
if ( (int) get_option( 'maison_calista_navigation_id' ) > 0 ) {
  $ok[] = 'FSE wp_navigation created';
} else {
  $errors[] = 'FSE navigation post missing';
}
if ( wp_get_theme()->is_block_theme() ) {
  $ok[] = 'Gutenberg FSE block theme';
} else {
  $errors[] = 'Not a block theme';
}
$patterns = glob( get_template_directory() . '/patterns/*.php' );
$ok[] = 'Patterns on disk: ' . ( is_array( $patterns ) ? count( $patterns ) : 0 );
$filtered = function_exists( 'maison_calista_filter_locale' ) ? maison_calista_filter_locale( 'en_US' ) : '';
if ( 'fr_FR' === $filtered ) {
  $ok[] = 'French frontend locale filter OK';
} else {
  $errors[] = 'French locale filter failed: ' . $filtered;
}
$en_meta = $home ? get_post_meta( $home->ID, '_maison_calista_content_en', true ) : '';
if ( is_string( $en_meta ) && strlen( $en_meta ) > 50 ) {
  $ok[] = 'English home content meta stored';
} else {
  $errors[] = 'English content meta missing on home';
}
foreach ( $required as $slug ) {
  $p = get_page_by_path( $slug );
  if ( $p ) {
    wp_delete_post( $p->ID, true );
  }
}
update_option( 'maison_calista_demo_installed', 1 );
update_option( 'maison_calista_demo_schema', '1.0.0' );
update_option( 'page_on_front', 0 );
update_option( 'show_on_front', 'posts' );
set_theme_mod( 'nav_menu_locations', array() );
if ( maison_calista_demo_is_complete() ) {
  $errors[] = 'demo_is_complete should be false after wipe';
} else {
  $ok[] = 'Incomplete state detected after wipe';
}
maison_calista_run_setup_safe( true );
if ( maison_calista_demo_is_complete() ) {
  $ok[] = 'Self-heal restored complete demo';
} else {
  $errors[] = 'Self-heal FAILED';
}
$missing2 = array();
foreach ( $required as $slug ) {
  if ( ! get_page_by_path( $slug ) ) {
    $missing2[] = $slug;
  }
}
if ( $missing2 ) {
  $errors[] = 'Still missing after heal: ' . implode( ',', $missing2 );
} else {
  $ok[] = 'All core pages restored after heal';
}
if ( function_exists( 'pll_set_post_language' ) ) {
  $ok[] = 'Polylang available';
}
$ok[] = 'PHP ' . PHP_VERSION;
$ok[] = 'WP ' . get_bloginfo( 'version' );
$ok[] = 'schema ' . get_option( 'maison_calista_demo_schema' );
$report = array( '=== Maison Calista 1.3.3 demo installer test ===' );
foreach ( $ok as $line ) { $report[] = 'PASS: ' . $line; }
foreach ( $errors as $line ) { $report[] = 'ERROR: ' . $line; }
$report[] = 'RESULT=' . ( $errors ? 'FAIL' : 'PASS' );
$text = implode( "\n", $report ) . "\n";
@mkdir( '/output', 0777, true );
file_put_contents( '/output/activation-result.txt', $text );
echo $text;
